selection_rule: Fold 3 is the top-level alias because it is the latest chronological selected fold and the best explainability/PnL compromise: meaningful W6/W10/W20 use, some cash/exits, zero invalid actions, and eval-to-test consistency. Fold 2 is kept for explainability demos but is not the alias because its held-out PnL is much weaker.

interpretability_notes.fold0: High PnL, but mostly W4/W6 with almost no cash; useful result, weaker story.
interpretability_notes.fold1: Positive PnL, but nearly always W6; too close to a fixed-width policy.
interpretability_notes.fold2: Most visibly mixed policy with meaningful cash, exits, and all widths; good visualization/demo fold, but weaker PnL.
interpretability_notes.fold3: Best shipped compromise: mostly W10/W6, occasional W20/W4, some cash/exits, strong positive held-out PnL.
